newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in dull trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Wednesday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments. Some people are waiting for possible direction from Thursday's release of the (U.S.) weekly jobless claims figures," he said.
"But unless the numbers are way off market expectations, I don't think there will be much impact here. The market is going to move on range trade for the time being," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
Thursday/Friday and week-fixed were unchanged from Tuesday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/8 6-1/4 percent.
